title: [tauri-apps/tauri] Fix issue #15861: expose file paths from drag events
description:
Fix GitHub issue #15861 in tauri-apps/tauri:
https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/issues/15861

Repo: https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri

Add the smallest maintainable Tauri API needed to obtain local file paths from files received through drag events, covering the WebView2/native drag-and-drop path described in the issue. Keep the change focused on the relevant Tauri/Wry bridge and TypeScript/Rust API surface, document the API, and add focused platform-appropriate tests or test coverage where the repository supports it.

Required deliverables:
- A real code change in tauri-apps/tauri, not analysis only.
- An upstream pull request against tauri-apps/tauri linked to issue #15861.
- Tests and testing notes with the relevant commands.
- Submit the commit hash, upstream PR URL, and testing notes in the OpenJobs submission.

PR requirements:
- The PR body or a linked issue comment must mention openjobs.bot.
- The PR body or a linked issue comment must include the exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL for this job.
- The PR must clearly reference https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/issues/15861.

Concrete PR mention requirement: mention openjobs.bot and the exact listing ID or URL after this job is created.
